title.en: Z.ai Launches GLM-5.3 Flagship With Post-Trained Coding and Cybersecurity Capabilities
title.zhHans: 智谱 AI 发布后训练旗舰 GLM-5.3，主打 Agent 编程与网络安全能力

searchSummary.en: Z.ai launched GLM-5.3, leveraging post-training on an existing 743B base to deliver 1M context, 50% coding benchmark gains, and advanced cybersecurity performance.
searchSummary.zhHans: 智谱 AI 发布 GLM-5.3，在既有 743B 底座上通过强化后训练实现 1M 上下文、代码基准提升 50% 与网络安全前沿表现。

summary.en: On August 14, 2026, Z.ai launched GLM-5.3, an updated flagship model built upon its 743-billion-parameter base architecture. Powered by scaled-up post-training, the model features a 1,000,000-token context window and demonstrated major performance leaps in autonomous coding and cybersecurity evaluations.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 14 日，智谱 AI（Z.ai）正式发布旗舰模型 GLM-5.3。该模型基于其 7430 亿（743B）参数底座架构，通过大规模强化后训练实现能力突破，支持 100 万（1M）token 上下文窗口，并在自主编程与网络安全攻防评测中展现了显著提升。

narrative.en: Z.ai rolled out GLM-5.3 to its GLM Coding Plan and API developer tiers on August 14, 2026. Rather than retraining a larger base model, the company retained the 743B parameter architecture of GLM-5.2 and derived its capability gains entirely from extended reinforcement learning and specialized post-training recipes. On internal and public benchmarks, Z.ai reported a 50% coding score improvement over GLM-5.2 on Z.ai Code Bench, 28.3% on Terminal-Bench 3.0, and 84.5% on CyberGym. The model was initially made available via hosted cloud endpoints, with open-weights releases scheduled to follow a two-week safety and export review period.
narrative.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 14 日，智谱 AI 向其 GLM Coding Plan 与 API 开发者全面上线了 GLM-5.3。智谱并未重新训练更大规模的基础底座，而是保持了 GLM-5.2 的 743B 参数架构，所有能力提升均来自于扩展的强化学习与专业化后训练方案。官方自测与公开基准显示，GLM-5.3 在 Z.ai Code Bench 上的代码评分较 GLM-5.2 提升了 50%，Terminal-Bench 3.0 达到 28.3%，CyberGym 网络安全攻防达到 84.5%。该模型发布时先通过云端 API 交付，开源权重计划在完成两周的安全审查后分阶段提供。

description.en: Demonstrates that extensive post-training on a 743B base yields significant gains in long-horizon coding and cybersecurity tasks without retraining base weights.
description.zhHans: 证明了在 743B 底座上进行深度后训练可在不重训底座的情况下，在长流程编程与网络安全任务中实现显著提升。

description.en: Increases competition in high-performance developer subscription tiers and cloud coding agent APIs.
description.zhHans: 加剧了高性能开发者订阅计划与云端编程智能体 API 市场的商业竞争。

text.en: On August 14, 2026, Z.ai launched GLM-5.3 with a 743B base architecture, 1M context window, and enhanced post-training.
text.zhHans: 2026 年 8 月 14 日，智谱 AI 发布基于 743B 底座架构、具备 1M 上下文窗口与深度后训练的 GLM-5.3。

text.en: Reported a 50% improvement in coding scores over GLM-5.2 and strong scores across Terminal-Bench and CyberGym in vendor evaluations.
text.zhHans: 官方自测报告代码得分较 GLM-5.2 提升 50%，并在 Terminal-Bench 和 CyberGym 上取得前沿成绩。

text.en: At launch, access was limited to API and Coding Plan users, with benchmark gains awaiting independent third-party confirmation.
text.zhHans: 发布初期访问仅限于 API 和 Coding Plan 用户，各项基准提升仍待第三方独立复现。

editorial.reviewNotes: Published after official Z.ai documentation release, developer rollout, and independent benchmark review. Reviewed 2026-08-24 after the latest-30 evidence, calibration, and language audit.

changeLog.summary: Calibrated significance from L2 to L1, changed consensus to emerging, unlinked enterprise-workflows direction, and adjusted evidence grades to reflect vendor benchmark status.
